[[File:Itharius's Cave.jpg|thumb|300px|Itharius's Cave]]

'''Itharius's Cave''' is the current residence of the mysterious [[high elf]] [[Itharius]]. It is located in the far southwestern corner of the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. The area outside the cave is filled with unruly green [[whelp]]s, which Itharius has taken it upon himself to watch over while they grow.
